headline: PROP weakness and delisting action at AKS anchor the session; TPOLY debenture default (S57) remains the highest-impact disclosure.
market_take: Coverage was mixed and skewed negative. PROP was the heaviest drag, led by RML (-11.11% gap-down, now down 11.1% over 5 days) and RABBIT (-9.09%), with WIN and RICHY also marking intraday weakness. AGRI and FOOD were pressured by GFPT (-8.18% on a 3.1σ volume spike) and CPF (-5.21% on 2.35× volume). On the upside, TRITN (+50.00% intraday) and EMC (+100.00% intraday) generated the day's standout moves, while KC (+50.00%) and TPOLY (+11.11%) recovered despite a fresh S57 debenture default filing for TPOLY. Total alerts (35) were concentrated in PROP and CONS.
